lessons.title: Project: The Siphon Garden System II — Build and Test
lessons.focus: Install tubes, start siphons safely, measure flow at each outlet; map flow vs head difference.
lessons.advanced: Plot flow vs head; why does real flow fall below the √2gh ideal? (Friction in the tube.)

lessons.title: Project: The Siphon Garden System III — Troubleshoot and Maintain
lessons.focus: Air leaks, blockages, algae; priming ritual; seasonal checklist; handover document for next year's class.
lessons.advanced: Write the fault tree: no flow → (air in crest? inlet uncovered? outlet above inlet?) with a test for each branch.

lessons.title: Valves: The Heart of Every Pump
lessons.focus: One-way flap valves from inner-tube rubber; watch one work on a clear tube; heart valves analogy; check valves in pumps.
lessons.advanced: Explain the pumping cycle as two valves opening alternately; what failure does a leaking inlet valve cause?

lessons.title: Build: A Hand Diaphragm Pump I
lessons.focus: Bottle + rubber diaphragm + two flap valves = working lift pump; assemble the pump head.
lessons.advanced: Estimate litres per stroke from diaphragm displacement; predict strokes per jerrican.

lessons.title: Build: A Hand Diaphragm Pump II — Performance Test
lessons.focus: Measure L/min at lift heights 0.5/1.0/1.5 m; graph performance; compare against a commercial pump spec.
lessons.advanced: Fit flow vs height trend; compute the pump's useful power at 1 m lift (P=ρgQh).

lessons.title: The Hydraulic Ram: Water That Pumps Itself
lessons.focus: Water hammer: stop a flowing column suddenly and pressure spikes; ram pumps lift a fraction high using only falling water; Kenyan hillside sites.
lessons.advanced: Explain the ram cycle (waste valve, delivery valve, air chamber) as momentum becoming pressure.

lessons.title: Teacher-Led Build: A Mini Ram Pump I
lessons.focus: Bottle air-chamber + two flap valves + drive pipe; teacher-led assembly of a demonstration ram.
lessons.advanced: Compute the drive head and delivery head of your rig; estimate the efficiency fraction Q·H/(q·h).

lessons.title: Teacher-Led Build: A Mini Ram Pump II — Tuning
lessons.focus: Tune waste-valve weight and air chamber; measure delivery per minute; discuss real installations (AidFoundation/ram pump groups).
lessons.advanced: Why does the air chamber smooth the delivery flow? Quantify with your pulsation count before/after.

lessons.title: Irrigation Physics: Drip, Furrow and Sprinkler
lessons.focus: Drip needs little pressure, sprinkler lots; gravity drip kits from a raised jerrican; water budgeting for dry seasons.
lessons.advanced: A bed needs 5 mm of water on 4 m² daily: compute litres/day and the drip-line hours at your measured rate.

lessons.title: Rivers, Bridges and Floods: Motion at Large Scale
lessons.focus: Fast water undermines bridge piers (scour); flood energy; gabions and check dams slow water; Kenyan flood examples.
lessons.advanced: Explain with KE∝v² why doubling flood speed quadruples its destructive energy per unit mass.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Water Works Expo
lessons.focus: All pumps and the siphon garden running; student engineers explain; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Write the expo quiz's hard question: a two-valve pump fault diagnosis with full reasoning.
